## Send requests

The endpoint serves the OpenAI chat completions API. Any OpenAI client works with a short-lived SageMaker token:

```python
from openai import OpenAI
from sagemaker.core.token_generator import generate_token

region, endpoint = "us-east-1", "deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017-g7e-24xlarge"
client = OpenAI(
    base_url=f"https://runtime.sagemaker.{region}.amazonaws.com/endpoints/{endpoint}/openai/v1",
    api_key=generate_token(region=region),
)
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "What is the capital of France?"}],
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)
```

## Clean up

Endpoints are billed per hour while they run. Delete the stack when you are done, from the CloudFormation console or with:

```bash
aws cloudformation delete-stack --region us-east-1 --stack-name deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017-g7e-24xlarge
```
